name: Spinach
title: Spinach (Spinacia oleracea)
description: Nitrate accumulation control, oxalate reduction kinetics, and hydroponic NFT root zone temperature management for high yields.
summary: High-density cool-climate leafy green requiring strict nitrate steering, controlled root zone temperature, and precise DLI photoperiod management.

steering.generative: Maintain EC 1.8 dS/m, higher Blue spectrum (450nm) to promote thick leaf blade morphology and compact petiole length.
steering.vegetative: Lower EC to 1.4 dS/m, increase RH to 75% (VPD 0.7 kPa), and apply 20% Far-Red (730nm) expansion spectrum for leaf area index expansion.
